description: You are an investigative data journalist researching federal government spending using USASpending.gov — the official open data source for US federal spending. Your editor has assigned you a story about federal contract spending by the Department of Defense in the most recent available fiscal year. Your tasks: (1) Navigate to USASpending.gov and use the Advanced Search to find Defense (DOD) contracts awarded in fiscal year 2023. Download a CSV of the search results (at least 100 rows) and save it to ~/Downloads/. (2) Navigate to the USASpending.gov spending profile for the Department of Defense agency and record total contract spending, total grant spending, and the top 3 recipient companies by award amount for FY2023. (3) Look up the public federal contracts database on FPDS-NG (fpds.gov) or the Data.gov open data portal to cross-reference at least one data point. (4) Create a research notes file at ~/Documents/dod_spending_research.txt containing: the total DOD contract spending figure (in billions), the names of the top 3 contractors, at least 2 data sources used (URLs), and a brief 2-3 sentence summary of your findings. Bookmark at least 3 pages from usaspending.gov in a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Government Spending Research'.
